actions.name: Register on the Russkoe TV website using the following link:
Enter your username, email address, password, and password confirmation.
A confirmation link will then be sent to your email address. Click the link to verify your email address.
After that, log in to the website using the credentials you provided during registration.

name: Activating the trial period and/or purchasing a package

actions.name: Russkoe TV allows you to activate a free one-day trial once, at any time you choose. To activate the trial, go to the home page and select "Get a Free Trial".
When the trial period expires, if you wish to continue watching, return to this step to top up your balance and purchase a package.
To top up your balance, select "Home" in the left-hand menu, then go to "Your Balance" and add funds using whichever payment method is most convenient for you.

name: Copying the playlist to your device's media player

actions.name: Go to your account dashboard, select "Home", and then choose "Settings".
Next, copy the playlist URL from the "Auto-Updating Playlist" section.
Do not share your credentials (key or playlist) with third parties. If simultaneous viewing from different devices is detected, your account will be blocked!
